name: 198. Provider-injected MCP web search (injected-web-search)
description: Provider config `injected_tools` lists MCP tools that Bifrost adds to every chat and responses request for the provider under the name each entry gives, and executes server side when the model calls them. A name replaces any client tool of the same name, and the name `web_search` also replaces any native web search the client sent. The harness profile points `openai_websearch` and `anthropic_websearch` at `sse_mcp/web_search` under the name `web_search`, and `openai_injectedtools` at the same tool under the name `lighthouse_lookup` (examples/mcps/remote-test-server), whose single result states a fact no model knows: the lighthouse is teal-and-amber and its keeper is Orrin Vale. An answer naming Orrin proves the gateway ran the search and fed the result back; every case also pins that the client never sees the injected tool call. `sse_mcp` keeps `web_search` out of its tools_to_execute, so the cases also prove the injected tool bypasses the client allow-list. Red before the feature: the profile field is unknown and no turn runs the tool.
